entities.summary: Joyce Johnson is an American author of fiction and nonfiction, whose writing has been closely associated with the Beat Generation. She was also a child actress and appeared in the Broadway production of I Remember Mama, which she went on to write about in her 2004 memoir Missing Men. Joyce Johnson was a authors & novelists from New York City (b. 1935-09-27, New York City). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
